scope: Bounded DXF transport for DWG VIEW group 361 SUN hard-owner references
claim_effect: Generated transport is covered; this does not qualify physical producer breadth, native SUN semantics, or whole-document output.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1
authority.finding: The R2007+ VIEW handle stream includes group 361 Sun handle as a hard owner.

implementation.behavior: The adapter now treats typed VIEW records as eligible SUN hard owners, checks the VIEW handle against the SUN common owner and unique-owner rules, and the low-level VIEW writer emits group 361 only through the validated/remapped SUN resolver. Layout validation requires the same resolved SUN closure.

assertions: typed VIEW group 361 binds to a unique SUN whose parentHandle matches the VIEW handle
group 361 survives handle remapping and fresh typed DXF readback
SUN object class count and raw SUN payload remain consistent

unqualified_dictionary.reason: The retained dictionary entry and common owner do not establish the group-361 hard-owner route; the profile remains refused.

local_physical_observation.strict_cli_result: Exit 1; preflight reports SUN owner graph closure incomplete/orphaned; no output file is published.

validation.cli_recheck_result: Expected fail-closed exit 1; /private/tmp/sun-owner-graph-after-view.dxf was not created.

remaining: Resolve whether the dictionary-owned 0x360 SUN is a valid producer profile and establish a standards-backed ownership/output mapping before admitting it.
Physical producer coverage, native rendering behavior, and composed whole-document qualification remain open.
